corrections.why: The register's detail page gives N 47.395217 W 121.145450 for the Kittitas County site, and the Wikipedia summit entry (47.397476, -121.144723) agrees to within a few hundred metres. The listing value used in the brief (also on the firelookout.org Washington list) is about 19 miles away to the southeast.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two sources (register detail page and Wikipedia summit entry) agree on the Kittitas point; the firelookout.org listing differs. The story does not use coordinates; the correction above proposes the register point.
Register gives 5,703 ft for the lookout site; Wikipedia gives 5,880+ ft for the summit. These may be different points rather than a true error, so the story gives only the register figure.

sources.title: Red Mountain Lookout Site, Former Fire Lookout Sites

notes_for_editor: Thin history: one detailed register entry plus a Washington listing and a summit article. No staffing, fire or access records found. Do not confuse with the WTA 'Red Mountain Lookout' (Glacier Peak Wilderness, Darrington Ranger District, Snohomish County), a different site, not used. Register photo captions carry no image URLs, so no photos added. Both searches returned nothing describing the summit today. Fact-check 2026-10-10: story's 'national listing' corrected to the Washington list (firelookout.org is a state list); the Ground type is the listing's Type column.
